item.description:

item.title: RTT: Credit risk management and financial stability: the role of leveraged finance in supporting businesses, the transmission of credit shocks, and implications for the resilience of financial intermediaries and markets (Univ. PERUGIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-28 23:59
Institution: Univ. PERUGIA, Perugia
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/ECON-09 Economia degli intermediari finanziari e finanza aziendale

The research project examines the formation and transmission of credit risk across bank loans, focusing on the role of leveraged finance in supporting corporate investment, acquisitions and growth, as well as the risks associated with high levels of indebtedness. By combining credit risk models with network analysis of interconnections between borrowers and lenders, it investigates the relationship between exposure sharing, risk diversification and systemic vulnerabilities. It also explores the impact of sustainability factors on credit quality and the verifiability of corporate ESG commitments. The ultimate objective is to develop tools to assess the resilience of financial intermediaries…

item.title: RTT: Artificial intelligence, firm investment and financing (Univ. URBINO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-24 23:59
Institution: Univ. URBINO, Urbino
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/ECON-01 Economia politica
